reason: The hypothesis proposes a specific, non-obvious intervention: a post-synthesis sulphur-atmosphere heat treatment to precipitate MoS2 along grain boundaries in a bulk HEA. No passage combines these elements; P16/P19 mix MoS2 powder into an HEA via SPS, which is a different approach, and no passage uses a sulphur atmosphere to form MoS2 in situ within an HEA. The idea is a new synthesis of known concepts (MoS2 lubrication, in situ precipitation, HEA matrix) not suggested by any single source.
copied_elements: MoS2 as a solid lubricant with low shear strength (general knowledge, P16, P19)
reduction of coefficient of friction and wear rate (general knowledge, many passages)
post-synthesis thermal treatment to modify microstructure (P21, P27, P43)
in situ formation of lubricious phase (P6, P8, P12, P17, P25)
